conventions.name_keys: board text rows reference data/names/names.json ids; names.json language keys are en/si/tn (tn = Tamil); si/tn are null (needs-review) so the board falls back to en until reviewed
conventions.side: left/right of the traffic the sign serves; drive on the left; chain direction = that traffic
conventions.lateral_from_kerb_m: post centre behind the kerb face (0.6 default, 0.7 for 1.6 m boards). Never less than 0.5.
conventions.bottom_height_m: above the road crown at the post: 2.2 footway-side signs, 2.0 boards, 1.5-1.0 island/median signs
conventions.kerb: kerb distance from the chain centreline is the carriageway half width; on the sea-side NB kerb it is 3.7 m in parking gaps and 11.8 m beside the parking lane (fix 5)
conventions.world_xz: DRAFT, +-3 m, computed from the OSM road graph; the build re-evaluates station + side + offset on the built road
conventions.NB_s: metres north of the ring exit along the NB line (fix 5 stations); SB s is metres from the north end, ring entry at s = chain length
